sections.title: باب 1 — متن (62)

paras.text: … brought about. The manner in which he ﷺ announced prophethood is unique in itself. He ﷺ went outside Makkah and climbed up a high hill. In Makkah it was proclaimed that I am present beside the hill. The special and the common were invited. When people gathered, he ﷺ said: if I tell you that beyond this hill there is an army, will you believe what I say? All said with one tongue: yes! why not. We know that you ﷺ have never lied in your whole life; you are as-Sadiq and al-Amin. Then he ﷺ said: O people! listen! Allah is One. He is One, without partner. The idols you worship are not God. The Prophet's ﷺ invitation to monotheism did not please the people sunk in the swamp of disbelief and polytheism, and they returned to their homes. But the manner in which he ﷺ, with the testimony of his truthfulness above all, began freedom of thought and conveyed the invitation of truth to people — its far-reaching effects followed, and in only twenty-three years an Islamic state was established on the basis of freedom of thought. Gradually the Islamic state became so vast, strong and modern that practical plans began to be made for casting lassos upon the stars. It is on this basis that the Ummah of Islam was commanded that whatever the Messenger ﷺ gives you, take it, and whatever he forbids you, refrain from it.

paras.pashto: … راوست. هغه ﷺ چې په کوم انداز د نبوت اعلان وکړ، هغه بې‌ساری دی. هغه ﷺ له مکې بهر یوې لوړې غونډۍ ته وخوت. په مکه کې اعلان وشو چې د غونډۍ تر څنګ حاضر شئ. خاص و عام راوبلل شول. کله چې ټول خلک راغونډ شول، هغه ﷺ وفرمایل: که زه تاسو ته ووایم چې د دې غونډۍ هاخوا یو لښکر دی، ایا زما خبره به ومنئ؟ ټولو په یوه خوله وویل: هو! ولې نه. موږ پوهېږو چې تا ﷺ په ټول عمر کې هېڅکله دروغ نه دي ویلي، ته الصادق او الامین یې. بیا هغه ﷺ وفرمایل: خلکو! واورئ! الله یو دی، هغه یوازې او بې‌شریکه دی. هغه بتان چې تاسو یې عبادت کوئ، خدای نه دي. د کفر او شرک په خټو کې ډوبو خلکو ته د نبي کریم ﷺ د توحید بلنه خوښه نه شوه او کورونو ته ستانه شول. خو هغه ﷺ چې له ټولو څخه د خپل صداقت شاهدي واخیسته او په کوم انداز یې د فکر ازادي پیل کړه او خلکو ته یې د حق بلنه ورسوله، د هغې لرې‌اغېزې پایلې راڅرګندې شوې، او یوازې په درویشتو کلونو کې د فکر د ازادۍ پر بنسټ اسلامي دولت جوړ شو. ورو ورو اسلامي سلطنت دومره پراخ، پیاوړی او عصري شو چې پر ستورو د کمند اچولو عملي تدبیرونه پیل شول. همدا وجه ده چې اسلامي امت ته حکم وشو چې رسول اکرم ﷺ تاسو ته هر څه درکړي هغه واخلئ، او له هر څه چې منع کړي، ترې ډډه وکړئ.

paras.text: Translation: They are severe against the disbelievers and merciful among themselves.

… brought about. The manner in which he ﷺ announced prophethood is unique in itself. He ﷺ went outside Makkah and climbed up a high hill. In Makkah it was proclaimed that I am present beside the hill. The special and the common were invited. When people gathered, he ﷺ said: if I tell you that beyond this hill there is an army, will you believe what I say? All said with one tongue: yes! why not. We know that you ﷺ have never lied in your whole life; you are as-Sadiq and al-Amin. Then he ﷺ said: O people! listen! Allah is One. He is One, without partner. The idols you worship are not God. The Prophet's ﷺ invitation to monotheism did not please the people sunk in the swamp of disbelief and polytheism, and they returned to their homes. But the manner in which he ﷺ, with the testimony of his truthfulness above all, began freedom of thought and conveyed the invitation of truth to people — its far-reaching effects followed, and in only twenty-three years an Islamic state was established on the basis of freedom of thought. Gradually the Islamic state became so vast, strong and modern that practical plans began to be made for casting lassos upon the stars. It is on this basis that the Ummah of Islam was commanded that whatever the Messenger ﷺ gives you, take it, and whatever he forbids you, refrain from it.

وَمَآ اٰتٰىكُمُ الرَّسُوْلُ فَخُذُوْهُ ۚ وَمَا نَهٰىكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانْتَهُوْا ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ (الحشر: 7)

Translation: And whatever the Prophet ﷺ gives you, take it, and whatever he forbids you from, refrain from it. And keep fearing Allah.

He ﷺ not only changed the traditional manner of worship, but rather changed the very routines of thinking, understanding and practical life. He ﷺ brought such a revolution in thinking that people who were each other's enemies became devoted to one another and began to give preference to others over their own needs; those who did not even know how to graze cattle properly became the leaders of the age; and those who lived as victims of mutual quarrels — to what astonishing extent they became like milk and sugar with one another. The Wise Quran has drawn the picture thus:

اَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى الْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيْنَهُمْ (الفتح: 29)

Translation: They are severe against the disbelievers and merciful among themselves.

The divine saying is:

وَيُؤْثِرُوْنَ عَلٰٓى اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ (الحشر: 9)

Translation: And they give preference to others over themselves, even though they themselves be hungry.

In short, the Noble Prophet ﷺ completely transformed Arab society and lit such a lamp of freedom of thought that the beauty of life came forth in its full splendour. He ﷺ, with great comprehensiveness, defined the rights of parents, children, relatives, neighbours, travellers and the needy, and granted such an art of living whose splendours dazzle even modern civilisation today.

Because of his ﷺ comprehensive and all-embracing teachings, Allah the Exalted made obedience and following of him ﷺ obligatory for Muslims till the Day of Judgement, and declared his ﷺ pure life the perfect example. The divine saying is:

لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِيْ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ اُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ (الاحزاب: 21)

Translation: Indeed, for you the life of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is the best example.

On the occasion of the Farewell Sermon (Khutbah Hajjat al-Wida'), the Noble Prophet ﷺ presented such a charter of respect for humanity which encompasses all aspects of the human rights of the present age. A summary of his ﷺ sermon is given below.

"People! Indeed your blood, your property and your honour are mutually as worthy of respect for one another as this day of today, this month and this city are worthy of respect. O people! Allah has erased all the pride and genealogical arrogance of the Age of Ignorance. Your Lord is One, your father is one; you are all the children of Adam (peace be upon him), and Adam (peace be upon him) was created from clay. No Arab has any superiority over a non-Arab, nor a non-Arab over an Arab. The criterion of superiority is only taqwa (God-consciousness). A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim.
